sheets.title_text:
1.1 HTTPS/TLS - EXTERNAL WEB SERVICES
Policy Requirement: All externally accessible web services MUST use TLS encryption with valid certificates from trusted CAs (Policy Section 2.2.1)
sheets.subtitle_text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 | Control A.8.24: Use of Cryptography

sheets.title_text:
1.2 HTTPS/TLS - INTERNAL WEB SERVICES
Policy Requirement: Internal web services containing sensitive data (Confidential or Restricted classification) MUST use TLS (Policy Section 2.2.1)
sheets.subtitle_text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 | Control A.8.24: Use of Cryptography

sheets.title_text:
2.1 EMAIL ENCRYPTION
Policy Requirement: Emails containing classified information (Confidential or Restricted) MUST be encrypted when sent externally (Policy Section 2.2.2)
sheets.subtitle_text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 | Control A.8.24: Use of Cryptography

sheets.title_text:
2.2 DIGITAL SIGNATURES
Policy Requirement: Digital signatures RECOMMENDED for all external emails, REQUIRED for legal/financial/official communications (Policy Section 2.2.2)
sheets.subtitle_text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 | Control A.8.24: Use of Cryptography

sheets.title_text:
3.1 SECURE FILE TRANSFER
Policy Requirement: File transfers containing sensitive data MUST use encrypted protocols (SFTP, FTPS, HTTPS). Unencrypted FTP is PROHIBITED (Policy Section 2.2.3)
sheets.subtitle_text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 | Control A.8.24: Use of Cryptography

sheets.title_text:
4.1 VPN (VIRTUAL PRIVATE NETWORK)
Policy Requirement: All remote access to organisational networks MUST use encrypted VPN with approved protocols (IPsec, WireGuard, OpenVPN). MFA REQUIRED (Policy Section 2.2.4)
sheets.subtitle_text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 | Control A.8.24: Use of Cryptography

sheets.title_text:
4.2 SSH (SECURE SHELL)
Policy Requirement: SSH REQUIRED for all administrative and remote terminal access. SSH protocol version 2 REQUIRED, password authentication SHOULD be disabled (Policy Section 2.2.4)
sheets.subtitle_text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 | Control A.8.24: Use of Cryptography

sheets.title_text:
4.3 RDP (REMOTE DESKTOP PROTOCOL)
Policy Requirement: RDP connections MUST be encrypted using TLS. RDP MUST NOT be directly exposed to the Internet (Policy Section 2.2.4)
sheets.subtitle_text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 | Control A.8.24: Use of Cryptography

sheets.title_text:
5.1 API SECURITY
Policy Requirement: API endpoints MUST use HTTPS with TLS 1.2+. API authentication MUST use OAuth 2.0, API keys (256-bit entropy), or mutual TLS (Policy Section 2.2.5)
sheets.subtitle_text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 | Control A.8.24: Use of Cryptography

sheets.title_text:
6.1 DATABASE CONNECTIONS
Policy Requirement: Database connections MUST use encrypted protocols (TLS for PostgreSQL/MySQL, encrypted connections for MSSQL) (Policy Section 2.2.6)
sheets.subtitle_text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 | Control A.8.24: Use of Cryptography

sheets.title_text:
6.2 WIRELESS NETWORKS
Policy Requirement: Wireless networks MUST use WPA3-Enterprise or WPA2-Enterprise minimum. WEP and WPA (original) PROHIBITED (Policy Section 2.2.6)
sheets.subtitle_text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 | Control A.8.24: Use of Cryptography

sheets.title_text:
7.1 CLOUD DATA TRANSMISSION
Policy Requirement: Connections to cloud provider APIs MUST use TLS 1.2+. Private connectivity options (PrivateLink, Private Link, Private Service Connect) RECOMMENDED for high-volume or sensitive data (Policy Section 2.2.7)
sheets.subtitle_text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 | Control A.8.24: Use of Cryptography

sheets.title_text:
1. PASSWORD SECURITY - PASSWORD AUTHENTICATION CONTROLS
Policy Requirement: Passwords MUST be hashed using approved algorithms (bcrypt, Argon2, PBKDF2, scrypt). Minimum 12 characters, complexity requirements enforced (Policy Section 2.5.1)
sheets.subtitle_text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 | Control A.8.24: Use of Cryptography

sheets.title_text:
2. MULTI-FACTOR AUTHENTICATION (MFA) - STRONG AUTHENTICATION
Policy Requirement: MFA REQUIRED for all administrative access, remote access, and access to Confidential/Restricted data. Approved factors: TOTP, Push notification, Hardware token, Biometric (Policy Section 2.5.2)
sheets.subtitle_text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 | Control A.8.24: Use of Cryptography

sheets.title_text:
3. CERTIFICATE-BASED AUTHENTICATION - PKI & DIGITAL CERTIFICATES
Policy Requirement: Certificate-based authentication REQUIRED for service accounts, automated processes, and high-security environments. Certificates issued from trusted CA with proper key management (Policy Section 2.5.3)
sheets.subtitle_text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 | Control A.8.24: Use of Cryptography

sheets.title_text:
4. SERVICE ACCOUNTS - NON-HUMAN AUTHENTICATION
Policy Requirement: Service accounts MUST use certificate-based authentication or long random passwords (≥20 characters). Password expiry disabled with monitoring. MFA or certificate preferred (Policy Section 2.5.4)
sheets.subtitle_text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 | Control A.8.24: Use of Cryptography

sheets.title_text:
5. SSO & FEDERATION - CENTRALIZED AUTHENTICATION
Policy Requirement: SSO/Federation REQUIRED using SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, or WS-Federation. Identity Provider (IdP) must enforce strong authentication and MFA (Policy Section 2.5.5)

sheets.title_text:
1. KEY GENERATION - CRYPTOGRAPHIC KEY CREATION
Policy Requirement: Cryptographic keys MUST be generated using approved algorithms with cryptographically secure random number generators (Policy Section 2.4.1)
sheets.subtitle_text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 | Control A.8.24: Use of Cryptography

sheets.title_text:
2. KEY STORAGE - SECURE KEY PROTECTION
Policy Requirement: Cryptographic keys MUST be stored in hardware security modules (HSM), cloud KMS, or TPM for production systems. Software keystores permitted only for non-production with documented risk acceptance (Policy Section 2.4.2)
sheets.subtitle_text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 | Control A.8.24: Use of Cryptography
sample_row: Example: Azure Key Vault - App1 Keys

sheets.title_text:
3. KEY ROTATION - CRYPTOGRAPHIC KEY LIFECYCLE MANAGEMENT
Policy Requirement: Cryptographic keys MUST be rotated according to defined schedules: Encryption keys annually, signing keys biennially, session keys hourly/daily (Policy Section 2.4.3)
sheets.subtitle_text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 | Control A.8.24: Use of Cryptography

sheets.title_text:
4. KEY BACKUP & RECOVERY - BUSINESS CONTINUITY
Policy Requirement: Cryptographic keys MUST have documented backup and recovery procedures. Backup keys stored with equal or greater security than production keys (Policy Section 2.4.4)
sheets.subtitle_text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 | Control A.8.24: Use of Cryptography

sheets.title_text:
5. CERTIFICATE MANAGEMENT - DIGITAL CERTIFICATE LIFECYCLE
Policy Requirement: Digital certificates MUST be issued from trusted Certificate Authorities. Certificate lifecycle management includes issuance, renewal, revocation, and expiration monitoring (Policy Section 2.4.5)
sheets.subtitle_text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 | Control A.8.24: Use of Cryptography

sheets.title_text:
6. KEY DESTRUCTION - CRYPTOGRAPHIC KEY DISPOSAL
Policy Requirement: Cryptographic keys that have reached end-of-life MUST be securely destroyed and destruction documented (Policy Section 2.4.6)
sheets.subtitle_text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 | Control A.8.24: Use of Cryptography
